caption: The drawing depicts a cylindrical stoneware jug with a wide mouth and two small loop handles on opposite sides near the upper portion. The jug is rendered in shades of light brown and gray, with some speckling suggesting a rough texture. The rim and interior of the jug are slightly darker, emphasizing the thickness of the material. On the front surface of the jug, there is a simple blue decorative motif comprising two stylized flower-like forms connected by a stem, positioned beneath the number "3" painted in blue. The background is plain and an off-white color, with a few faint brown stains or marks, and the edges of the paper show some discoloration or aging. The composition shows the jug prominently centered and occupying most of the frame.
title: Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
